name: Coteach
description: Coteach helps K-12 math educators create classroom-ready diagrams directly in Claude. Describe the visual you need in plain language, and Coteach generates up to four separate math diagrams. It is useful for lesson planning, worksheets, practice problems, and visual scaffolds such as number lines, tape diagrams, arrays, area models, coordinate planes, and fraction models.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Coteach to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Coteach to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://coteach.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Coteach MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coteach provides these MCP tools: CreateDiagrams.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Coteach?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Coteach in education on the Manufact MCP catalog include DocCheck Flexikon, Vocaneo, Grammaropolis, TheWholeTorah, and Fryd - Your Gardening Companion.
Coteach requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Coteach is developed by Coteach. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
